messages:
Noah (partnerships): heads up - NimbleEdge reported a hardware fault during a private deployment test yesterday. It escalated to a sev1 when the on-prem fallback failed. We need a partner SEV playbook tailored for HW/SI integrations (shared channels, vendor handoffs, physical escalation checklist). Ideas?
Priya (eng): absolutely. HW SEVs are different: we need explicit "on-site" vs "remote" paths. On-site requires SI contact + access window + escalation to vendor field engineer. Remote is typical war room.
Sam (eng-sre): propose dual-channel pattern: one ephemeral war room for technical triage (#partner-hw-nimbleedge-s1) and a separate logistics channel for on-site coordination (#partner-hw-nimbleedge-s1-logistics). The bot should create both when on_site=true.
Olivia (support): support must own initial triage and confirm whether customer has an approved SI or on-prem ops contact. If not, that delays things — include a pre-filled customer consent template for onsite visits.
Diego (ops): logistics checklist (short): 1) site contact + phone 2) access hours + badge info 3) required spare parts list 4) SI oncall + escalation number 5) travel ETA. We'll pin as a form in the logistics channel.
nimble-bot: [auto] Received SEV webhook: partner=nimbleedge, severity=1, deployment_type=onprem, site_country=DE. Creating channels: #partner-hw-nimbleedge-s1 and #partner-hw-nimbleedge-s1-logistics. Inviting: Noah, Olivia, Sam, Priya, Diego, nimble-edge-rep.
Noah (partnerships): naming conv proposal: "#partner-hw-{partner}-{sev}{-sitecode?}". e.g. "#partner-hw-nimbleedge-s1-de-ber01" if we want site specificity. Keep optional sitecode.
Priya (eng): automation rules: if deployment_type==onprem then create logistics channel, attach on-site runbook, and add field-engineer contact card. Also, add a TTL that prevents auto-arch until both channels have status=closed.
Sam (eng-sre): escalation timing: S1 on-prem -> immediate war room w/in 3m; if on-site required -> initiate logistics channel and page SI vendor. If vendor not ACK in 15m escalate to exec oncall. Bot should monitor ACK timers.
Olivia (support): communications: every 30m ETA update for customers + partner rep. For onsite work, add a safety confirmation step and shared photo receipts when hardware swapped.
Diego (ops): add template snippet for logistics channel: "Site contact: \nAddress: \nAccess instructions: \nBadge info: \nSI oncall: \nSpare parts requested: \nTravel ETA: \nPhotos on replacement uploaded to artifact store: <link>"
nimble-bot: [auto] Posted triage template and logistics form to both channels. Set ACK timer: 15m for vendor reps.
Noah (partnerships): postmortem ownership: recommend OWNING split: Partnerships writes partner comms timeline; Support writes incident timeline and customer-facing summary; Eng (Priya/Sam) writes technical RCA; Ops attaches logistics timeline and receipts. Combine into one consolidated PM.
Priya (eng): also collect hardware serials, firmware versions, and syslogs into a single artifact bucket. Bot can attach collector script in the war room: ```/collect-logs --site=ber01 --serialize=s3://redwood-logs/nimbleedge/ber01/1712```
Sam (eng-sre): add a short Q/A for partners about expected SLAs for on-site vendor dispatch (e.g., 4h for EU / 8h for APAC) so expectations are clear and in the partner contract.
Olivia (support): can we add a quick command for support to request field engineer: `/request-field <partner-code> <sitecode> <priority>` that triggers vendor paging and auto-fills logistics info.
Diego (ops): yes, we'll prototype that in the workflow builder. Also need a GDPR check for taking photos on site - add consent confirmation in the logistics form.
nimble-bot: [auto] Vendor ACK missing at 00:15. Paging vendor escalation contact and exec-oncall.
Noah (partnerships): follow-ups: 1) Ops to build logistics template & workflow 2) Eng to add collector scripts and artifact bucket perms 3) Support to add /request-field command and consent template 4) Partnerships to update partner-contract SLAs. Can we do PRs by EoW?
Priya (eng): I'll open collector script PR Tue.
Sam (eng-sre): I'll publish ACK/monitoring rules and oncall mapping Wed.
Olivia (support): will prototype /request-field workflow and consent check Thu.
Diego (ops): I'll add logistics template and GDPR checkbox Fri.
Noah (partnerships): ok scheduled check-in Fri 9am PT to review playbook draft. Goal: no more than 10m to confirm vendor dispatch and clear ownership within 30m. Thanks all. :rocket:
